messages:
tanya: Heads-up from today's onboarding lab — the sample app's paginated export hits 429s for new accounts after ~6 pages. Users report the process never finishes, client keeps hammering.

oliver: Which sample app? JS or Python quickstart?

tanya: JS quickstart (the one that demonstrates client.paginate). Running local e2e with a small token quota mock.

ben: We saw this once: paginator does background prefetch (default 2), and the SDK's global retry logic will exponentially retry each failed prefetch. If the server returns Retry-After, the retries still spin because prefetch doesn't check it.

sara: Repro steps would help. Is there an easy repro we can point trainees at?

tanya: Yep, I added a tiny repro script in the sample-app repo under /scripts/repro-ratecap.js — it simulates token throttling and shows the looping retries. (Link pasted in the lab doc.)

ben: Short mitigation for the quickstart: set paginate options to disable prefetch and reduce retries. Example snippet I pasted in chat: ```js
const it = client.paginate('listItems', { prefetch: 0, concurrency: 1 });
for await (const page of it) { process(page.items) }
```

tanya: That stops the loop. Will add that to the onboarding note.

oliver: We should also consider defaulting the JS SDK to a "safe mode" for new installs: prefetch: 0 when API key age < 7 days or env var REDWOOD_SAFE_PREFETCH=true. Otherwise newbies keep hitting quotas.

ben: Hmm, auto-changing behavior based on key age could be surprising. Alternative: detect repeated 429 with Retry-After and dynamically pause prefetch. That keeps perf for power users but protects novices.

ci-bot: CI: sample-app/tests/pagination.js failed on throttling simulation (flaky) — rerun queued.

oliver: Action items: 1) Add onboarding quickstart note + sample config (tanya). 2) Add paginator change to respect Retry-After and support a per-instance shared token bucket (ben). 3) Add test that simulates token quota and ensures prefetch pauses (sara).

ben: I'll open an SDK PR to: a) check Retry-After on response and set a backoff timer that pauses prefetch, b) expose `prefetch` default in client constructor so quickstarts can flip it easily.

ci-bot: Notification: PR #4287 opened by ben: "js: paginator honor Retry-After and adjustable prefetch default"

tanya: Thanks — adding a brief "If you see 429s during pagination" troubleshooting card to the lab checklist with the workaround commands. Also linking the PR so trainees can follow the fix.

oliver: Good. Let's keep the quickstart text explicit about how pagination interacts with global token quotas — people assume it's per-route only.

ben: Tip for support teams: if a user reports infinite retries during paginate, ask for their paginate options and recommend `prefetch: 0, concurrency: 1, maxRetries: 2` until the SDK patch is rolled out.

sara: I'll add that to the internal runbook under "SDK pagination issues".

tanya: Closing the loop on onboarding fixes today. :smile:
